positioning.zh: 纯离线、零依赖、单文件的苏格拉底伴读工具，支持确定性问题、Reader Memory v2 与用户确认的跨书关系。
positioning.en: A fully offline, zero-dependency, single-file Socratic reading companion with deterministic questions, Reader Memory v2, and user-confirmed cross-book relations.

current_safe: explicit Chinese or English language choice
Reader Memory v2 in browser localStorage
concept, stance, question, and reflection entries
transient cross-book suggestions from shared tags or text keywords
supports, conflicts, extends, and exemplifies relations
two-step user confirmation before relation persistence
no server, network, API, model, key, shell, dependency installation, or ordinary filesystem persistence
query_clusters: reading companion without an API key

include: explicit request to use or open weread-socrates
explicit request for Socratic reading of a manually pasted WeRead passage
explicit request to continue local concepts, stances, questions, or reflections
explicit request to compare ideas across books with user-confirmed relations
exclude: note cleanup without the reading-companion intent
